data.one_liner: Open-source neutral-style system symbols and icons for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 3000 icons in outlined and filled styles designed on a 24x24 grid. Allows developers to easily display icons using RemixIcons or Remix classes.
use_when: You want to use the Remix Icon symbol set in your Flutter app.
You need a large library of consistent, neutral-style icons.
avoid_when: You are using a different icon set like FontAwesome or Material Icons exclusively.
You only need one or two simple icons and wish to avoid adding an icon dependency.
strengths: 3000+ icons with outlined and filled styles.
Free for both personal and commercial use.
Simple usage with static icon constants.
weaknesses: Increases app size by bundling the font file.
data.setup_notes: Add remixicon to pubspec.yaml dependencies and import it where needed.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the Font Awesome icon set instead of Remix Icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the Lucide icon set style.
